description.value: Sandhill Wines is an urban winery operating on the historic Calona Wines estate — established in 1932, it holds the distinction of being BC's original and oldest continuing winery. Crafting VQA wines since 1997 from grapes sourced across six vineyards in the Okanagan and Similkameen valleys, it offers guided tastings, curated food pairings, live music, and private events in the heart of downtown Kelowna. A touring cyclist finishing a day's ride into Kelowna will find it a short walk from the waterfront and city centre.
